ios.desc:
YAP (Yet Another Player) redefines mobile media playback with its innovative virtual knob gesture system. Simply rotate and tap on screen for effortless control - combining the convenience of mobile interactions with the natural feel of physical devices, while being even faster and more accurate.
The standard version of this app is free with ads. You can earn usage time by watching ads, or upgrade to the Premium version to remove ads and enjoy unlimited access.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Virtual Knob – New Gesture for Human-Machine Interaction

quotes.text:
I created a brand-new gesture that mimics knobs. Based on this, I built YAP, a media player that runs on Android and iOS. It uses knob gestures to adjust volume, brightness, and playback progress.

It's free, please try it at:
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/y-a-p/id6744711983

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ex3.yap

For more technical details, please read my blog:
https://benwu232.github.io/posts/virtual-knobs/

https://medium.com/@benwu232/virtual-knobs-making-human-machine-interaction-more-intuitive-and-efficient-35e0dfea47bf

https://dev.to/benwu232/virtual-knobs-making-human-machine-interaction-more-intuitive-and-efficient-247j

Please have a try and let me know what you think!
Thanks!
